<entry id="B01347">
<head-word>בִּשּׁוּל, </head-word>
<head-word>בִּישּׁוּל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (בשל) 
<italic>ripening, cooking; dish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 95
<sup>b</sup> זמן בי' פירות the season of the ripening of fruits.—Ḥull. 115
<sup>b</sup> sq. איסור ב', v. אִיסּוּר. Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>a</sup>; Y. Bets. I, 60
<sup>b</sup> top הותר מכלל בי' permitted as coming under the category of cooking (on Holy Days); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. בִּשּׁוּלים, בִּי'</plural-form>. Ab. Zar. 38
<sup>a</sup> בִּישּׁוּלֵי נכרים dishes prepared by gentiles. Ib. בישולי של עכ"ום (strike out של, v. Ms. M.); a. fr. [Gen. R. s. 49 אמר בישולה, v. בָּשֵׁל.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>בְּשׂוֹרָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">בְּשׂרָה; בָּשַׂר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>joy, glad tiding;</italic> in gen. 
<italic>tidings</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 16
<sup>b</sup> כוס של ב' cup of joy (wine carried in the bridal procession of a virgin), v. explan. ib.—Mekh. Bo. s. 12 ב' רעה evil prediction. Tanḥ. Ki. Thetse 4; Pesik. Zakh. p. 24
<sup>a</sup> בְּשׂוֹרַת אמו the news of his mother’s death; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. בְּשׂוֹרוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Keth. II, 26
<sup>b</sup> top חבית של ב' the keg of wine carried in the bridal procession, v. supra. Num. R. s. 14 (play on בשר Koh. XII, 12; Ezek. XXXVI, 26) the Lord sends thee ב' טובות good tidings. Ber. IX, 2 ב' טובות … שמועות רעות Mish. ed. (Talm. ed. 54
<sup>a</sup> ב' רעות, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) good tidings … bad news. Sabb. 63
<sup>a</sup> אין … ב' רעות no bad tidings will reach him.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01359">
<head-word>בָּשַׁל</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> √בש</xref>,
<xref rid="B00027"> sec. r. of באש</xref>,
<xref rid="B01003"> cmp. בשם</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> בשש)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to ripen, boil, be done</italic> (through natural or artificial heat).</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26
<sup>a</sup> ב' הזרע וכ' when the seed boils inside (maturity of genital organs), the pot outside becomes dark (genitals are covered with hair).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>בִּשֵּׁל, בִּישֵּׁל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to mature, cook, roast</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 95
<sup>b</sup> לבַשֵּׁל פירות to make the fruits ripen. Ḥull. 98
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Pes. 112
<sup>a</sup> לא תְבַשֵּׁל וכ' cook not in a pot which thy neighbor has used before thee (i.e. marry not a divorced woman).—Part. Pu. מְבוּשָּׁל. Ned. VI, 1 הנודר מן המב' וכ' he who vows abstinence from anything boiled, is permitted to partake of roasts &c. Ib. 49
<sup>a</sup> באתרא … קרו מב' in R. J.’s place they call roast likewise 
<italic>m’bushshal</italic> (cmp. II Chr. XXXV, 13); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְבַּשֵּׁל, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִתְבַּשֵּׁל 
<italic>to be boiled, done, ripe.</italic> Ter. X, 11. Ḥull. VII, 4; a. fr.—Ib. 98
<sup>b</sup> top, v. בָּשֵׁל.—Sot. 11
<sup>a</sup>; Ex. R. s. 1 בקדרה שבשלו וכ' in the pot they boiled in, they were boiled, (they were done by as they did by others).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="B01360">
<head-word>בְּשַׁל, </head-word>
<head-word>בְּשִׁיל</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same;</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> as preced. Kal. Targ. O. Gen. XL, 10 ed. Berl. בְּשִׁילוּ (ed. בַּשִּׁילוּ, Pa.); Y. בָּשְׁלוּ; ib. IX, 20.—Part. pass. בָּשִׁיל, בְּשִׁילָא. Targ. O. Num. VI, 19; a. e.—Ab. Zar. 38
<sup>a</sup> אי לא הוה הפיך בה הוה ב' וכ' Ms. M. (ed. less corr.) if he (the gentile) had not turned it, it would have been done in two hours.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>בַּשֵּׁיל, בַּשֵּׁל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> as preced. Pi. Targ. I Kings XIX, 21; a. fr.; v. supra.—Ab. Zar. 38
<sup>a</sup> לבַשּׁוּלֵי מנא to bake (in the furnace) the earthen vessel, contrad. to לשרורי to glaze, finish. Ḥull. 110
<sup>a</sup> ריבעא … בעי לב' how much milk is required to boil a quarter of a litra of meat?</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְבַּשַּׁל, אִיבְּשַׁל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> as preced. 
<italic>Hithpa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Deut. XXVI, 2; a. e.—Targ. I Sam. II, 13 כמִיבְּשַׁל (Var. כמְבַשֵּׁל).—Ab. Zar. 29
<sup>b</sup> אִיבְּשִׁיל.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="B01361">
<head-word>בָּשֵׁל</head-word>
<head-word>בְּשֵׁלָה, </head-word>
<head-word>בְּשֵׁי'</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>ripe, boiled, done</italic>.</definition>
<notes> זרוע בשלה the boiled shoulder due to the priest (Num. VI, 19). Ḥull. 98
<sup>a</sup> bot. both derive it מז' ב' from the process prescribed for the priest’s gift &c. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> top אין ב' אלא שלמה when it says, ‘the shoulder boiled’ it means entire (not carved). Ib. אין ב' אלא שנתבשל וכ' when it says, ‘He shall take &c. from the ram’ it means that it must be boiled joined to (or jointly with) the body of the ram. Tanḥ. Vayera 5 Abraham בלעה בשילה swallowed the fig ripe, i.e. spoke deliberately, opp. פגה; Gen. R. s. 49 אמר בישולה (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01364">
<head-word>בִּשְׁלָמָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="U01351">שְׁלָמָא</xref>) 
<italic>in peace, well</italic>, whence (as a dialectic term) 
<italic>granted, it is right, it would be right</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 7
<sup>a</sup> ב' שבת … אלא וכ' it is right as far as ‘a Sabbath’ is concerned, for it may happen on an eve of Passover concurring with a Sabbath, but (when it says) ‘on a Holy Day’, how can &c.? Ib. 24
<sup>b</sup> ב' אי … שפיר וכ' I grant, if …, it would be right (to infer that &c.), but now &c. Ib. 50
<sup>a</sup> ב' למאן דאמר … היינו it is right according to him who says …, but according to &c.; a. v. fr. אי אמרת ב' = ב' אי אמרת, v. אִי II.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01367">
<head-word>*בַּשְׁקַר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (Pashel of בקר) 
<italic>to search, discover</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XLIV, 22 (h. text חקר). Ib. XXVII, 4 ולבשקרה ed. Lag. 
<italic>to find the truth, speculate</italic> (ed. ולבקרא, h. text ולבַקֵר).—Yeb. 120
<sup>a</sup> he passed before them with a plaster on his face ולא בשקרוה and they (the officers) did not discover it (the disguise; for Var. v. Ar. ed. Koh. s. vv. בליתא a. בשקר). Erub. 19
<sup>a</sup> ולא מְבַשְׁקַר ליה and he (Abraham) does not discover the disguise; Ar. (taking מב' as part. pass.) and he (in his disguise) is not discovered (as a Jew). *Bekh. 36
<sup>b</sup> חזייה בשקריה he saw him, and discovered his fraud, v. Tosaf.; (ed. a. Rashi חזייה בשִׁיקְרֵיה looked at his fraud). [Targ. Y. II Deut. IV, 34 לִמְבַשַׁר, Var. למבשׂר, read: לִמְבַשְׁקַר.] V. מְבַשְׁקְרָנָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01368">
<head-word>בָּשַׂר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="B01012">בָּסַר II</xref> a. 
<xref rid="A00083">בָּסַם)</xref>
<italic>to be sweet, pleasant</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>בִּשֵּׂר, בִּישֵּׂר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to gladden, to bring good tidings to;</italic> in gen. 
<italic>to announce</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 87
<sup>a</sup> מְבַשֵּׂר טובות וכ' I am bringing good news. Sabb. 63
<sup>a</sup>, v. בְּשׂוֹרָה; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְבוּשָּׂר 
<italic>informed of good news, assured</italic>. Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>b</sup> top יהא מב' מחיי העו"הב he shall receive a message from the life in the world to come, i.e. he may be assured of salvation; Y. Keth. XII, 35
<sup>a</sup> מכושר לחיי וכ' … (corr. acc.); Y. Shek. III, end, 47
<sup>c</sup> יהא מב' שבן עו"הב הוא. Ex. R. s. 46 אתה מב' שמחלתי וכ' thou art informed that I have forgiven thee &c. Y. Ber. V, end, 9
<sup>d</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְבַּשֵּׂר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be gladdened, to receive good tidings</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 42 נ' בבנים he was assured that he would have children. Gen. R. s. 47; s. 53 נתבשרה בחלב she was assured that she would nurse her child. [V. בָּסַר II.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<head-word>בָּשָׂר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="B01370">preced.</xref>) [
<italic>ripe, warm, sweet, well-looking;</italic> v. Freitag Arab.</definition>
<notes> Dict. s. v. bšr, a. cmp. לֶחֶם] 
<italic>body</italic> (b. h.); 
<italic>flesh, meat</italic>. Ḥull. VIII, 1 כל הב' any kind of meat. Ib. 16
